definitions.explanation: A style of sushi in which vinegared rice and toppings are pressed together in a rectangular wooden mold, then cut into pieces. Especially associated with the Kansai region.

examples.japanese: {押|お}し{寿司|ずし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{押|お}し{寿司|ずし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
examples.english: Osaka is famous for pressed sushi.
I made pressed sushi by putting vinegared rice and toppings into a wooden mold.

notes:
A style of sushi where vinegared rice and toppings are pressed together in a rectangular wooden mold ({押|お}し{型|がた}), then cut into pieces. Predates the more widely known ⟦{握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}→握り寿司：19145_nigirizushi⟧ (hand-pressed sushi) and is especially associated with the Kansai region, particularly Osaka.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{押|お}し{寿司|ずし}: mackerel pressed sushi
- {押|お}し{寿司|ずし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧: pressed sushi mold
- ⟦{柿|かき}→柿：04384_kaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{葉|は}→葉：02241_ha⟧{寿司|ずし}: persimmon leaf sushi (a type of pressed sushi from Nara)

CULTURAL NOTE:
{押|お}し{寿司|ずし} is one of the oldest forms of sushi in Japan. The ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧{寿司|ずし} (mackerel sushi) of Kyoto and the ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧{寿司|ずし} (box sushi) of Osaka are well-known regional varieties. It is also a popular ⟦{駅弁|えきべん}→駅弁：09702_ekiben⟧ (station lunch box) item.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{握|にぎ}り{寿司|ずし}→握り寿司：19145_nigirizushi⟧: hand-pressed sushi — the Tokyo-style sushi most people think of
- ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧{寿司|ずし}: box sushi — another name for pressed sushi, especially in Osaka
- ⟦{巻|ま}き{寿司|ずし}→巻き寿司：12410_makizushi⟧: rolled sushi — sushi rolled in seaweed
